results.title: 10-K 1 d845977d10k.htm FORM 10-K Form 10-K
results.snippet: A 2015 10-K says the company distributes about 140,000 SKUs of replacement parts and fasteners, and claims a leading position in supplying "dealer exclusive" items. Fasteners in that filing include oil drain plugs, wheel bolts, and lug nuts.

results.title: 10-K 1 form10k.htm DORMAN PRODUCTS 10-K 12-30-2006 Dorman Products 10-K 12-30-2006
results.snippet: A 2006 10-K says products go mainly to U.S. aftermarket retailers such as AutoZone, Advance, and O'Reilly, plus warehouse distributors such as Carquest and NAPA, with specialty markets and salvage yards also served.

results.title: 10-K 1 d293461d10k.htm FORM 10-K Form 10-K
results.snippet: A 2017 10-K names NAPA among its warehouse distributor customers.

results.title: Dividend Power Score
results.snippet: A third-party profile says Dorman mainly serves repair professionals, national and regional parts retailers, warehouse distributors, and fleet maintenance providers. The same profile notes that its products reach international markets mostly indirectly through distributors.
